kamp.split: Reuse train78 / validation22 / previously-seen development test36. Never choose on test36.
kamp.cv: Three expanding time folds inside train78; purge batch overlap; fold-training Q3 defines each fold's target. Fit preprocessing/selection on fold train only.
kamp.selection: Highest mean fold AP selects one candidate before reading candidate validation results; tie-break fewer inputs then id.
kamp.threshold: Train out-of-fold predictions: maximize F2, precision, higher threshold, subject to alert_rate<=0.40. Grid0.05..0.95 step0.025 plus abstain1.000001.
kamp.review_budget_status: Internal demonstration assumption; not a user or factory operating requirement.
kamp.deployment_gate: Winner must on validation22 achieve AP>=baseline+0.05, F2>=baseline, recall>=0.75, precision>=baseline+0.10, alerts<=0.50; paired AP bootstrap95% lower bound>0; must preserve original input contract. Otherwise keep current deployed RF.
kamp.uncertainty: Validation has4 positives and was used previously; passing the gate still does not establish external generalization.
kamp.test: Reproduce frozen baseline; score only the preselected candidate once after deployment decision. Report as development reference, never reconsider selection.

secom.scope: Separate semiconductor benchmark. Never pool with KAMP or claim heat-treatment external validation.
secom.split: Chronological unique calendar days 60%train/20%validation/20%test, rounded down; same day never crosses splits. Freeze manifest before training.
secom.cv: Three expanding unique-day folds within training; train-only missingness<=40%, variance/correlation pruning, median imputation, ANOVA selection.
secom.selection: Highest mean train-fold AP; no validation/test model selection. Same OOF threshold40% budget. Lock model+threshold hashes before opening test evaluation.
secom.test: One untouched chronological holdout evaluation after selection. Same dataset, not new factory external validation.
